business_problem: Deutsche Telekom needed to redesign customer care, network operations, and employee workflows at telecom scale, rather than adding isolated AI tools to legacy processes.
solution_summary: Deutsche Telekom is using OpenAI as the foundation for becoming an AI-native telco. The company started by rolling out ChatGPT Enterprise to employees so experimentation and fluency could spread broadly, then moved into redesigning high-volume operational workflows instead of stopping at productivity assistance. Customer care became an early focus, with AI systems that can gain context, learn from interactions, and reduce handoffs and wait times. In parallel, Deutsche Telekom is bringing AI directly into voice and communications experiences through live translation, in-call assistants, and post-call summaries so customers do not need to adopt a separate app to benefit. AI is also being applied to network operations, where Deutsche Telekom works with partners to optimize mobile-network performance dynamically as demand changes throughout the day. This combination of employee adoption, operational redesign, and embedded communications intelligence is how the company is translating AI from experimentation into a new telecom operating model.

data_flow: Employee prompts flow through ChatGPT Enterprise for everyday work, while customer-service and voice interactions are processed through AI systems that add context, translation, assistance, and summarization. Network-operations data is analyzed continuously so resources can be adjusted in real time as demand changes.
business_outcome: Deutsche Telekom established a company-wide AI-native transformation strategy, sharply increased AI usage, and began redesigning both customer and network experiences around always-available conversational intelligence.
